name: professional-slides
description: Create and revise editable PowerPoint decks.

interface.longDescription:
Professional Slides creates and revises editable PowerPoint decks in Codex or Claude Code. Start from a brief, an existing presentation, or a slide image. A new deck starts from a storyline you approve - the reader, the answer, the page count and the data behind each page - before any page is built. Preview alternative layouts for a selected slide, restyle the deck while keeping every word and number, reconstruct an image as native editable elements, or develop a named brand profile with editable template and style-guide slides.

The npm setup command installs a persistent portable skill and checks the local environment with a real Office export. Desktop Microsoft PowerPoint or LibreOffice and Poppler must be installed locally; the npm package does not supply them.

All workflows use the shared layout, PowerPoint emission, rendering, readback and validation pipeline. The agent inspects the saved output. Image reconstruction is agent-assisted; uncertain content stays explicit. Eligible charts have embedded workbooks; custom chart treatments use editable shapes. An independent review is available when requested.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $professional-slides to create or revise a decision-ready executive deck and verify the final editable artifact.

publication.release_notes: Updated the Professional Slides skill and bundled authoring runtime, including competitive positioning templates, existing-deck import, environment checks, evidence handling, table treatments, and rendered review gates. Packaged as a standalone skills-only plugin with portable, Codex, and Claude Code manifests.

review.commerce_description: Professional Slides does not involve payments or purchases.
